$comment: Optional QRSPI local config. Copy to .qrspi/config.json (gitignored) to use it. REVIEWERS: by default — with no config file — the qrspi-batch finalizer requests review from '@me' (the gh-authenticated user running the harness), so a fresh clone needs zero setup and ships no hard-coded username. 'reviewers' are GitHub logins (the literal '@me' expands to the authenticated user; set [] to request no reviewer); 'teamReviewers' are Graphite/GitHub team slugs ('org/team' or 'team'). LINEAR: 'linearTeam' is the Linear team /qrspi-ticket files new issues under (if unset, the skill discovers/asks); 'linearProject' is the Linear project, defaulting to 'QRSPI' — it scopes BOTH ticket creation (/qrspi-ticket files new issues under it) AND batch runs (qrspi-batch sweeps only this project's assigned tickets by default; pass {"project":"..."} to override for one run, or {"allProjects":true} to sweep every project). CRITICS: 'critics.design' (optional) overrides the design-phase multi-lens critic panel — 'maxRounds' caps the produce→critique→revise loop (default 2) and 'lenses' selects which lens agents run (default all four: completeness, internal-consistency, edge-alignment, simplicity). Omit the whole 'critics' block to use the defaults; unknown lens names are dropped and an empty resolved set falls back to the default four. Each lens id maps to the agent .claude/agents/qrspi-design-critic-<id>.md. 'candidates' (numeric, default OFF) enables the design-phase N-select stage: when N>1 the design phase produces N candidate designs under orthogonal framings (mvp-first, risk-first, extensibility-first), a judge scores them, the highest-scoring wins, and runner-up ideas are grafted in. Absent / non-numeric / <=1 ⇒ N=1 (OFF — the single produce agent runs as today, zero extra spawns); values are clamped to [1,3] (the framing count), clamping down with a log line. The single-critic planning phases 'critics.questions', 'critics.research', 'critics.structure', and 'critics.plan' (optional) each take only 'maxRounds' (a positive integer; default 2) to cap their produce→critique→revise edge-critic loop — there is no 'lenses'/'candidates' knob for these single critics. An absent block or a non-positive-integer maxRounds falls back to 2. The 'research' phase additionally runs a deterministic citation node-check (scripts/qrspi_verify_citations.py) on its staged artifact before the critic; this gate is NOT configurable here.
